Engraving of a woman in a long dress and headscarf using a long-handled tool to work with a large wooden basket, labeled Fig. 9.

Page from a 1725 book featuring an ornate floral header, a small circular portrait, and Italian text addressed to 'Illustriss. Signore'.

Title page of Historia Vitis Viniferae by Remigius Corvinus, printed in Cologne in 1575, featuring a coat of arms and publisher details.
